notes: Modified cash basis school district; governmental funds only (Nutrition Program is in Other Governmental Funds), so business_type is null. Top-level figures use the Total Governmental Funds column (p4-p5); beginning/ending cash = beginning/ending total fund balance (19,868,586 / 21,277,164), which equals cash plus county treasurer balances (p6). Balance sheet is the government-wide asset/net position section (p3), no liabilities. Several fund schedules (p7-p21) are budget-basis and the statement's General Fund column on p4-p5 combines General, Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds (statement GF receipts 29,324,400 = schedule 29,260,413 + 63,983 + 4), so General Fund schedule figures differ from the statement; detail uses only the schedules (no double counting with the statement-level lines). Schedule lines with a budget but no actual (e.g. Sale of bonds, Debt services 5000, Federal programs 4530, Mitigation, Tuition received from other districts, Qualified Capital Purpose disbursements budget 3,965) are omitted. GF schedule lists the functions by program code without object breakdown, so expenditure detail_category is 'not itemized'; state and federal program spending is classed as instruction by guess. Hidden transfer: the Depreciation Fund shows 1,040,000 'Transfer - General Fund (as disbursed from the General Fund)'; the General Fund schedule disbursements (28,600,058) include it (statement GF disbursements 28,754,543 = 28,600,058 + 1,272,755 + 1,730 - 1,040,000 - 80,000), so a -1,040,000 contra line and matching other financing line are recorded; the lines holding it are not printed. GF schedule line 8000 'Transfers and other' 80,000 equals the Activities Fund transfer and is recorded as other financing -80,000. Detail 'includes other financing' on totals that include these. On p17 Special Building 7,865 is 'Interest and penalty on property taxes' but the p4 statement presents it as Motor vehicle taxes. Read pages 1-21 of 21.
